_comment: Relational calculus → SQL golden cases, run against the database in ra_to_sql.json (declared above every input by the tests). `sql` is the DuckDB output; `sql_datafusion`, where present, is what the DataFusion setting writes instead.

cases.name: trc-select-project
trc-exists-join
cases.input: { e.name | Employee(e) ∧ ∃d ( Department(d) ∧ d.id = e.dept_id ∧ d.location = 'Berlin' ) }

cases.name: trc-range-sugar-in-words
cases.input: { e.name | e in Employee and exists d in Department ( d.id = e.dept_id and d.location = 'Berlin' ) }

cases.name: trc-not-exists
trc-forall
cases.input: { s.name | Student(s) ∧ ∀c ( Course(c) → ∃e ( Enrolled(e) ∧ e.sid = s.sid ∧ e.cid = c.cid ) ) }

cases.name: trc-disjunction-becomes-union
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.name
FROM Employee AS t
WHERE t.salary > 65000
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT t.name
FROM Student AS t;

cases.name: trc-set-difference
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.sid
FROM Student AS s
EXCEPT
SELECT DISTINCT e.sid
FROM Enrolled AS e;

cases.name: trc-definition
cases.input:
Rich = { e.name, e.dept_id | Employee(e) ∧ e.salary > 50000 }
{ r.name | Rich(r) ∧ ∃d ( Department(d) ∧ d.id = r.dept_id ∧ d.location = 'Paris' ) }
cases.sql:
WITH Rich AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.name, e.dept_id
  FROM Employee AS e
  WHERE e.salary > 50000
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM Rich AS r
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Department AS d WHERE d.id = r.dept_id AND d.location = 'Paris');

cases.name: trc-latex-export
drc-select-project
cases.input: { ⟨n, s⟩ | ∃i, d ( Employee(i, n, s, d) ∧ s > 50000 ) }

cases.name: drc-join-by-shared-variable
cases.input: { ⟨n⟩ | ∃i, s, d, dn ( Employee(i, n, s, d) ∧ Department(d, dn, 'Berlin') ) }
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.name
FROM Employee AS e, Department AS d2
WHERE d2.id = e.dept_id
  AND d2.location = 'Berlin';

cases.name: drc-ellipsis
drc-forall
cases.input: { ⟨n⟩ | ∃s ( Student(s, n) ∧ ∀c, t ( Course(c, t) → Enrolled(s, c) ) ) }

cases.name: drc-disjunction-becomes-union
cases.input: { ⟨n⟩ | ∃i, s, d ( Employee(i, n, s, d) ∧ s > 65000 ) ∨ ∃i ( Student(i, n) ) }
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.name
FROM Employee AS e
WHERE e.salary > 65000
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT s2.name
FROM Student AS s2;

cases.name: drc-negation
drc-ascii
cases.input: { <n> | EXISTS i, s, d ( Employee(i, n, s, d) AND s > 50000 AND d = 1 ) }
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.name
FROM Employee AS e
WHERE e.salary > 50000
  AND e.dept_id = 1;
